items.title: A scoping review of psychosocial factors of climate change inaction: implications for climate change communication and education
items.title_en: A scoping review of psychosocial factors of climate change inaction: implications for climate change communication and education
items.title_zh: 关于气候变化不作为的心理社会因素的范围性综述：对气候变化传播与教育的启示
items.summary_en: Climate change communication and education efforts often focus on the cognitive aspects of addressing climate change, emphasizing that a key path to solving climate change-related challenges may be achieved through an educated public that better understands the science of this issue. However, despite decades of information-heavy communication and education efforts, designed with knowledge-related outcomes in mind, meaningful and sustained action to address climate change has yet to occur at a broad scale. This lack of effective, sustained action has motivated researchers from a range of fields to examine other factors that prevent climate change action. We undertook a systematic scoping review of peer-reviewed, empirical studies (n = 92) focusing on psychological and sociological (psychosocial) factors associated with climate change inaction. Through thematic analysis, we identified trends and patterns across the studies, but also noted that no obvious list of discrete psychosocial factors associated with climate inaction emerged. Political ideology and emotions were the most common factors discussed as influencing climate change inaction. Other psychosocial factors receiving notable attention included climate change perceptions, trust in institutions and leaders, values, and efficacy beliefs. The most-recommended strategies for improving effectiveness of climate change communication and education were attending to climate-related emotions; addressing issues of ideology and trust; and targeting systemic and structural barriers. Findings also emphasize that quality climate communication and education must acknowledge and build on people’s unique relationships with their places, communities, and stories.
items.summary_zh: 气候变化传播与教育工作往往侧重于应对气候变化的认知层面，强调解决气候变化相关挑战的关键途径之一，可能是通过提高公众科学素养，使其更好地理解这一问题的科学原理。 然而，尽管数十年来开展了大量以知识传播为目标、信息密集型的传播与教育工作，但针对气候变化的有意义且持续的行动尚未在广泛范围内实现。这种有效且持续行动的缺失，促使来自多个领域的研究人员开始探讨阻碍气候变化行动的其他因素。 我们对聚焦于与气候变化不作为相关的心理和社会学（心理社会）因素的同行评审实证研究（n = 92）进行了系统性范围综述。 通过主题分析，我们识别出了各研究中的趋势和模式，但也注意到，尚未形成一份与气候不作为相关的、明确的独立心理社会因素清单。 政治意识形态和情绪是被讨论最多的、影响气候变化不作为的因素。其他受到显著关注的社会心理因素包括对气候变化的认知、对机构和领导者的信任、价值观以及效能信念。 为提高气候变化传播与教育成效，最常被推荐的策略包括：关注与气候相关的情绪；解决意识形态和信任问题；以及针对系统性和结构性障碍。研究结果还强调，高质量的气候传播与教育必须承认并基于人们与其所处环境、社区及个人故事之间的独特联系。

items.title: Identifying the indirect cost of work in high-heat conditions
items.title_en: Identifying the indirect cost of work in high-heat conditions
items.title_zh: 确定高温条件下工作的间接成本
items.summary_en: The impact of excess heat on labor productivity and/or labor supply are a key contributor to the total economic impact of climate change on the macroeconomy. Previous studies do not adequately distinguish between the short run labor response to excess heat and indirect costs to health and well being, or quantify the additional indirect toll of extreme heat. Empirically, workers typically exceed international safety standard work hours under hot conditions, suggesting they are incurring indirect costs in order to reduce production losses. Here we take a simple agent-based perspective on this question, supposing that workers and their employers make this tradeoff optimally. Based on this and a few other simple assumptions we infer that workplace heat impacts on human health and well being may be an appreciable fraction—perhaps 20%–80%—of economic losses. This implies that current studies underestimate the true costs of workplace heat in the present, and especially, future climates.
items.summary_zh: 过热对劳动生产率和/或劳动力供给的影响，是气候变化对宏观经济总体影响的关键因素之一。以往的研究未能充分区分过热引发的短期劳动力反应与对健康和福祉造成的间接成本，也未能量化极端高温带来的额外间接损失。 实证研究表明，在高温条件下，劳动者通常会超出国际安全标准的工作时长，这表明他们为了减少生产损失而承担了间接成本。本文从简单的基于代理模型的角度探讨这一问题，假设劳动者及其雇主会以最优方式进行这种权衡。 基于这一假设及其他若干简单假设，我们推断工作场所高温对人类健康和福祉的影响，可能占经济损失的相当大一部分——或许为20%–80%。这意味着当前的研究低估了工作场所高温在当下，尤其是未来气候条件下的真实成本。

items.title: Within-fire estimates of biomass loss across national forests of the US West Coast: inventory-informed inference with uncertainty
items.title_en: Within-fire estimates of biomass loss across national forests of the US West Coast: inventory-informed inference with uncertainty
items.title_zh: 美国西海岸国家森林中单次火灾内生物量损失的估算：基于资源清查数据且考虑不确定性的推断
items.summary_en: Wildfire is reshaping forests in the western United States (US), yet estimates of wildfire impacts often rely on burned-area summaries or satellite-derived severity metrics that do not directly quantify changes in forest biomass or their uncertainty. We combine US Forest Inventory and Analysis plot measurements with annual 30 m tree canopy cover data in a Bayesian spatio-temporal modeling framework to estimate within-fire changes in live aboveground biomass (AGB) and forest mortality area across National Forest System lands in Washington, Oregon, and California. The model represents both live forest presence or absence and AGB conditional on live forest, allowing posterior predictive estimates of pre- and post-fire conditions at the pixel scale. Applied to 6308 fire analysis areas from 2000 to 2022, the analysis estimates 117.8 million Mg of wildfire-associated AGB loss and 2.98 million ha of forest mortality area, with the largest aggregate impacts occurring in 2020. Pixel-level estimates reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity within fire perimeters, including large differences between total burned area, forest mortality area, and associated biomass loss. This inventory-informed, uncertainty-aware approach provides a scalable framework for quantifying forest carbon impacts of disturbance across broad regions while retaining within-fire spatial detail.
items.summary_zh: 野火正在重塑美国西部的森林，但对野火影响的评估往往依赖于烧毁面积的汇总数据或基于卫星的严重程度指标，这些数据无法直接量化森林生物量的变化及其不确定性。 我们结合美国森林资源清查与分析（FIAS）的样地测量数据与年度30米分辨率树冠覆盖率数据，在贝叶斯时空建模框架下，估算了华盛顿州、俄勒冈州和加利福尼亚州国家森林系统土地范围内，单次火灾中活体地上生物量（AGB）及森林死亡面积的变化。 该模型既反映了活林的存亡状态，也考虑了以活林为条件的地上生物量，从而能够在像元尺度上对火灾前后的状况进行后验预测估计。 该分析应用于2000年至2022年的6308个火灾分析区，估算出与野火相关的地上生物量损失为1.178亿Mg，森林死亡面积为298万公顷，其中2020年的综合影响最为显著。 像元级估算结果揭示了火灾边界内的显著空间异质性，包括总过火面积、森林死亡面积及相关生物量损失之间的巨大差异。这种基于清查数据且考虑不确定性的方法，为量化大范围区域内扰动对森林碳的影响提供了一个可扩展的框架，同时保留了火灾内部的空间细节。

items.title: Earth's next ice age may have already begun. Global warming stopped it
items.title_en: Earth's next ice age may have already begun. Global warming stopped it
items.title_zh: 地球的下一次冰河时代可能已经开始了。全球变暖阻止了它的到来。
items.summary_en: Scientists have uncovered surprising evidence that Earth’s next ice age may have already begun, only to be stopped by global warming. By studying ancient plants preserved beneath the Barnes Ice Cap in the Canadian Arctic, researchers discovered that the remnants of a massive ice sheet began expanding again about 2,000 years ago, signaling the possible start of a new glacial period. But by the 1960s, rising temperatures had reversed that growth, causing the ice to shrink instead.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们发现了一项令人惊讶的证据，表明地球的下一次冰河时代可能已经开始，但随后被全球变暖所阻止。 通过研究加拿大北极地区巴恩斯冰盖下保存的远古植物，研究人员发现，约2000年前，一块巨大冰盖的残余部分开始再次扩张，这预示着新一轮冰期的可能开始。但到了20世纪60年代，气温上升扭转了这一扩张趋势，导致冰盖反而开始萎缩。
